job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain large-scale data pipelines using BigQuery, Data Flow, PubSub and other GCP services.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business requirements and design solutions that meet those needs.
Develop machine learning models using Python on Dataproc clusters for big data processing.
Troubleshoot complex issues related to pipeline failures or errors in the system.

Job Requirements :

4-10 years of experience in software engineering with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, MCP (Multi-Cloud Platform) architecture.
Strong understanding of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as BigQuery, Data Flow, PubSub etc. .
Proficiency in composing code snippets using Python programming language.
Experience working with cloud storage solutions like Cloud Storage.
